immutable_algorithm.threshold: At least 5% normalized RMSE lower in EACH of 3 sensor outputs on BOTH physically distinct public DEV acquisition traces against strongest actually scored conventional baseline per sensor; intact pretrained core checkpoint; otherwise fixed DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO and no new tuning on public DEV.
